name: Tower
long_description: Tower accelerates transactional due diligence via an AI-powered, centralized diligence platform. By consolidating disparate diligence workflows, Tower helps deal teams stay organized, spot issues earlier, and close deals faster.
one_liner: M&A due diligence platform powered by AI

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer: Both Adam and I both have strong conviction that legal services ought to be more accessible. We believe the current system is broken on both sides of the marketplace. Lawyers are bogged down by a variety of tasks which can and should be automated while their clients are encumbered with large legal costs arising from said tasks. We strongly view legal access as the core recipe for a functional and equitable society and believe that technology has a large role to play in getting us there. We interviewed hundreds of lawyers and found that there are many salient pain points being experienced by in-house legal teams which we’re well-equipped to solve given our in-depth backgrounds in software engineering and AI research.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer: When Tower truly succeeds, all lawyers will be able to focus on tasks which they attended law school for, such as advising their clients and applying their nuance to strategic matters. They will no longer have to waste their day performing low-value-add tasks such as searching through precedents or handling admin work. Clients, from the largest corporations down to the individual, will have access to quality legal services at affordable costs as legal professionals are freed from the tyranny of mundane work.

founders.title: Founder/CEO

Previously I was an early engineer at Float (corporate card for Canada), built software for speaker & microphone manufacturing at Apple, built AI software & performed AI computer-vision research at DarwinAI (acq. Apple). I studied Mathematical Physics at the University of Waterloo, where I co-oped in data-science/ML and software engineering.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Co-founder and CTO @ Tower; we're building helpful software so M&A folks can leave work at 5PM everyday. Before Tower I was the founding engineer of ArenaX Labs, a Web3 AI Gaming startup, where I helped the company from inception and zero users to Series A and a community of hundreds of thousands. Before this I did research at an investment trust, specializing in reinforcement learning and cool assets like crypto. I graduated from UWaterloo BCS and Laurier BBA.

launches.title: Tower - collaborative AI for due diligence
launches.tagline: We help deal teams collect the right disclosures faster and automate review.
launches.body:
Hi YC,

We’re Adam, Andy, and Noah - co-founders of Tower ([withtower.com](https://www.withtower.com/?utm_source=ycombinator&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=yclaunch&utm_content=launch_page))

## TL;DR

Tower is a collaborative AI diligence workspace. We take your DD checklist and messy data room, organize it, flag what’s missing, and let your team query everything with AI - so you spend time on analysis, not chasing information.

We’re live with AmLaw 50 and Chambers Band 1 law firms, top serial acquirers, and leading commercial real estate diligence teams.

<https://youtu.be/OZn3vZTupGs>

## The Problem

The hardest part of diligence isn’t reviewing documents - it’s collecting the right information. 

Deal teams have no dedicated system for collecting and verifying that disclosures are complete before analysis begins. Instead, they rely on multiple VDRs, Excel trackers, email threads, and one-off AI prompts to figure out what’s been received, what’s missing, and what matters. That process of chasing and structuring information is iterative, time-consuming, and kills deal momentum. 

Most AI tools help teams review documents faster. But you can’t review what you don’t have, and you can’t assess risk in documents you don’t know are missing. 

## The Solution

Tower is the workspace that takes deal teams from first disclosure to answers faster - by fixing collection first, then accelerating review.

**1. Automatically organized data room:** Upload anything, get a fully indexed deal room in minutes. Click any diligence request and see the exact files behind it.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101268&key=user_uploads/1450770/0ac92ee3-6a92-4b0f-8d35-176aa978f693)

**2. Catch red flags and missing files up front:** Missing amendments, unsigned agreements, stale financials, and expired contracts are flagged within seconds of upload, before anyone wastes review time.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101268&key=user_uploads/1450770/0e556183-5997-4b8f-b5a1-72fbd4b38bca)

**3. AI document review:** Extract covenants, financial definitions, change-of-control triggers, and rep language across hundreds of documents in one pass. Every answer cited to source.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101268&key=user_uploads/1450770/36914b9b-402a-4ce1-b78e-b1b3bd0341ab)

**4. Smart diligence Q&A:** Every request, every responder, every status, in one live system, synced with the data room. No more "what's the latest tracker?" email threads.

## The Backstory

Our team spent years on the wrong end of messy data rooms - burning weeks organizing and chasing disclosures before real review could begin. We watched deals stall and sour because of it. Tower is the system we wished we had on every one of those deals. 

Noah is a former M&A and tech lawyer at Dentons, where he co-led the AI industry practice and advised top Canadian startups. Andy was an ML quant at a $27B pension fund and founding engineer at NRN Agents. Adam was an early engineer at one of Canada's fastest-growing fintechs, and worked on data science in manufacturing at Apple.

## Our ask

* Warm intros to M&A partners at AmLaw 200 firms, corp dev leads at PE/strategics, and CRE acquisitions teams.
* Working on a deal? Book a demo with us.

Learn more at [withtower.com](https://www.withtower.com/?utm_source=ycombinator&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=yclaunch&utm_content=launch_page), or reach us directly at [founders@withtower.com](mailto:founders@withtower.com)
